column1: # City overrides: fix a city whose GeoNames point falls in the wrong region.
# Use only when the boundary data is right but the city's point is off. Every row needs a reason.
# geonameid : GeoNames id of the city
# region_id : the region key it must belong to (must exist in the build)

column3: Caracas: GeoNames point (10.488,-66.879) lies in Chacao municipality (Miranda); the city centre (Plaza Bolívar, 10.506,-66.915) and the capital are in Distrito Capital.
